_comment: Curated R2 layer for the Fonderie brain (BRAIN_PLAN.md Phase 1/2). Hand-maintained: closed-domain alias edges + recipes + invariants that structural extraction cannot infer. Merged into brain.json by scripts/generate-brain.mjs. Grows from corpus misses (experiments/brain-2026-07).

auth.accounts.description: sign up, log in, sessions, passwords, MFA, email verification

auth.oauth.description: social login / SSO via OAuth providers (Google, GitHub)

auth.route-guard.description: protect a route or page so only logged-in users reach it

billing.subscriptions.description: accept payments, subscription plans, Stripe checkout, invoices

billing.plan-gate.description: lock a feature behind a paid plan / entitlements / free-tier limits

workspaces.teams.description: teams, orgs, multi-tenancy, members, email invites

permissions.rbac.description: roles and permissions — admin/member/viewer, access control. Backend-only: @fonderie/permissions has no HTTP routes (server-side requirePermission/requireRole middleware + PermissionsEngine.can/.assert). For a frontend role-management UI, see react-workspaces.hooks / vue-workspaces.composables (useRoles, useMemberRoles) — role CRUD is exposed under @fonderie/workspaces' routes.

courier.messaging.description: SEND any transactional message — email, SMS, push; use this for password-reset, email-verification, welcome, and invite emails (auth.* is who can log in, courier is what delivers the message). No end-user-facing HTTP API — messages are sent server-side via the event bus, not called from a frontend. For an admin template-editor UI, see react-courier-admin.templates / vue-courier-admin.templates.

webhooks.in-out.description: receive webhooks (Stripe) and emit your own to other apps — full CRUD on outbound endpoints plus delivery history and test-send. Session-authenticated like billing/workspaces/audit (not the admin-token model courier-admin/config-admin use). For a frontend endpoint manager, see react-webhooks.hooks / vue-webhooks.composables.

events.bus.description: in-process event bus — react when something happens in another module

config.flags.description: feature flags, remote config, kill switches. No end-user-facing HTTP API — apps read config server-side or via defineConfig(); the only HTTP surface is the admin-token-guarded /admin/config and /admin/secrets management API. For an admin dashboard UI, see react-config-admin.admin / vue-config-admin.admin.

audit.trail.description: workspace-scoped audit log — who did what, compliance. One read-only route (GET /audit); no create/update/delete API since events are written internally by other modules. For a frontend log viewer, see react-audit.hooks / vue-audit.composables — session-authenticated like billing/workspaces, not the admin-token model courier-admin/config-admin use.

rate-limit.throttle.description: throttle requests — brute force, abuse, spam protection

customers.crm.description: customer records / CRM tied to billing

core.app.description: bootstrap a Fonderie app, register modules, mount on Express/Hono/Koa

react-auth.hooks.description: React hooks for auth — useLogin, useRegister, useSession, useLogout, useForgotPassword, useResetPassword, useVerifyEmail, wrapping @fonderie/client

react-auth.screens.description: pre-built React auth screens (LoginScreen, RegisterScreen, ForgotPasswordScreen) built on react-auth hooks — bring your own styling

react-native-auth.hooks.description: React Native hooks for auth — same shape as react-auth, token persisted to AsyncStorage instead of localStorage

react-native-auth.screens.description: pre-built React Native auth screens (LoginScreen, RegisterScreen, ForgotPasswordScreen) built on react-native-auth hooks

vue-auth.composables.description: Vue composables for auth — useLogin, useRegister, useSession, useLogout, useForgotPassword, useResetPassword, useVerifyEmail, wrapping @fonderie/client

vue-auth.screens.description: pre-built Vue auth screens (LoginScreen, RegisterScreen, ForgotPasswordScreen) built on vue-auth composables via Vue's h() render API

react-billing.hooks.description: React hooks for billing — usePlans, usePlan, useSubscription, useCheckout, useBillingPortal, useUsage, useRecordUsage, wrapping @fonderie/client's BillingClient

react-billing.screens.description: pre-built React billing screens (PricingScreen, SubscriptionScreen) built on react-billing hooks — bring your own styling

react-native-billing.hooks.description: React Native billing hooks — re-exports react-billing wholesale (no platform-specific storage, unlike auth)

react-native-billing.screens.description: pre-built React Native billing screens (PricingScreen, SubscriptionScreen) built on react-native-billing hooks

vue-billing.composables.description: Vue composables for billing — usePlans, usePlan, useSubscription, useCheckout, useBillingPortal, useUsage, useRecordUsage, wrapping @fonderie/client's BillingClient

vue-billing.screens.description: pre-built Vue billing screens (PricingScreen, SubscriptionScreen) built on vue-billing composables via Vue's h() render API

react-workspaces.hooks.description: React hooks for workspaces — useWorkspaces, useCreateWorkspace, useMembers, useRemoveMember, useInvitations, useAcceptInvitation, useWorkspaceSettings, plus role management (useRoles, useUpdateRole, useSetRolePermissions, useMemberRoles) — @fonderie/permissions has no HTTP API of its own, role CRUD lives here under @fonderie/workspaces' routes. Wraps @fonderie/client's WorkspacesClient.

react-workspaces.screens.description: pre-built React workspaces screens (TeamMembersScreen, InviteMembersScreen) built on react-workspaces hooks — bring your own styling

react-native-workspaces.hooks.description: React Native workspaces hooks — re-exports react-workspaces wholesale (no platform-specific storage, unlike auth)

react-native-workspaces.screens.description: pre-built React Native workspaces screens (TeamMembersScreen, InviteMembersScreen) built on react-native-workspaces hooks

vue-workspaces.composables.description: Vue composables for workspaces — useWorkspaces, useCreateWorkspace, useMembers, useRemoveMember, useInvitations, useAcceptInvitation, useWorkspaceSettings, plus role management (useRoles, useUpdateRole, useSetRolePermissions, useMemberRoles) — @fonderie/permissions has no HTTP API of its own, role CRUD lives here under @fonderie/workspaces' routes. Wraps @fonderie/client's WorkspacesClient.

vue-workspaces.screens.description: pre-built Vue workspaces screens (TeamMembersScreen, InviteMembersScreen) built on vue-workspaces composables via Vue's h() render API

react-courier-admin.templates.description: React hooks for courier's email/SMS/push template admin API — useTemplates, useTemplate, useSaveTemplate, useDeleteTemplate, useTemplateRevisions (list + rollback). Admin-token authenticated via a standalone CourierAdminClient — does NOT share FonderieClient's session token with auth/billing/workspaces.

react-courier-admin.screens.description: pre-built React screens (TemplateListScreen, TemplateEditorScreen with revision history + rollback) built on react-courier-admin hooks — an admin-dashboard surface, bring your own styling

vue-courier-admin.composables.description: Vue composables for courier's email/SMS/push template admin API — useTemplates, useTemplate, useSaveTemplate, useDeleteTemplate, useTemplateRevisions (list + rollback). Admin-token authenticated via a standalone CourierAdminClient — does NOT share FonderieClient's session token with auth/billing/workspaces.

vue-courier-admin.screens.description: pre-built Vue screens (TemplateListScreen, TemplateEditorScreen with revision history + rollback) built on vue-courier-admin composables via Vue's h() render API — an admin-dashboard surface

react-config-admin.admin.description: React hooks for config's feature-flag/remote-config + secrets admin API — useConfigEntries, useConfigEntry, useSaveConfigEntry, useDeleteConfigEntry, useConfigRevisions and the secret equivalents (useSecrets, useSecret, useSaveSecret, useDeleteSecret, useSecretRevisions) plus useRevealSecret. Admin-token authenticated via a standalone ConfigAdminClient — does NOT share FonderieClient's session token with auth/billing/workspaces.

react-config-admin.screens.description: pre-built React screens (ConfigListScreen: config + masked secrets dashboard; ConfigEditorScreen: JSON/secret editor with revision history + rollback) built on react-config-admin hooks — an admin-dashboard surface, bring your own styling

vue-config-admin.admin.description: Vue composables for config's feature-flag/remote-config + secrets admin API — same set as react-config-admin.admin. Admin-token authenticated via a standalone ConfigAdminClient — does NOT share FonderieClient's session token with auth/billing/workspaces.

vue-config-admin.screens.description: pre-built Vue screens (ConfigListScreen, ConfigEditorScreen) built on vue-config-admin composables via Vue's h() render API — an admin-dashboard surface

react-audit.hooks.description: React hook for the audit log — useAuditEvents, cursor-paginated with type/actorId/date-range filters and loadMore. Read-only (@fonderie/audit has one route); session-authenticated like billing/workspaces, wraps @fonderie/client's AuditClient.

react-audit.screens.description: pre-built React screen (AuditLogScreen: type/actor filters, expandable JSON payload, load-more) built on react-audit's useAuditEvents — bring your own styling

react-native-audit.hooks.description: React Native audit log hook — re-exports react-audit wholesale (no platform-specific storage, unlike auth)

react-native-audit.screens.description: pre-built React Native screen (AuditLogScreen) built on react-native-audit's useAuditEvents

vue-audit.composables.description: Vue composable for the audit log — useAuditEvents, cursor-paginated with type/actorId/date-range filters and loadMore. Read-only (@fonderie/audit has one route); session-authenticated like billing/workspaces, wraps @fonderie/client's AuditClient.

vue-audit.screens.description: pre-built Vue screen (AuditLogScreen) built on vue-audit's useAuditEvents via Vue's h() render API

react-webhooks.hooks.description: React hooks for webhook endpoints — useWebhookEndpoints (list/create/delete), useWebhookEndpoint (get/update), useWebhookDeliveries (delivery history), useTestWebhookEndpoint (send a test event). Session-authenticated like billing/workspaces/audit, wraps @fonderie/client's WebhooksClient. createEndpoint's signing secret is only returned once, at creation.

react-webhooks-screens.screens.description: pre-built React screens (WebhooksListScreen: create form + list + test/delete + one-time secret banner; WebhookDetailScreen: edit form + delivery history) built on react-webhooks' hooks — bring your own styling

react-native-webhooks.hooks.description: React Native webhook hooks — re-exports react-webhooks wholesale (no platform-specific storage, unlike auth)

react-native-webhooks-screens.screens.description: pre-built React Native screens (WebhooksListScreen, WebhookDetailScreen) built on react-native-webhooks' hooks, using FlatList/TextInput/TouchableOpacity

vue-webhooks.composables.description: Vue composables for webhook endpoints — useWebhookEndpoints, useWebhookEndpoint, useWebhookDeliveries, useTestWebhookEndpoint. Session-authenticated like billing/workspaces/audit, wraps @fonderie/client's WebhooksClient. Endpoint IDs are read once at setup; call refresh() after changing them.

vue-webhooks-screens.screens.description: pre-built Vue screens (WebhooksListScreen, WebhookDetailScreen) built on vue-webhooks' composables via Vue's h() render API, emitting select-endpoint / navigate-list

invariants.jwt-secret-from-env: Read the auth JWT secret from process.env and throw if missing — never ship an insecure hardcoded fallback (the #1 scratch-build flaw, baseline round 0-baseline).
invariants.rate-limit-default-on: @fonderie/auth enables brute-force rate limiting by default (since auth 1.2.0); do not set rateLimit:false unless you have another limiter in front.
invariants.logout-provided: @fonderie/auth mounts POST /auth/logout with session invalidation — do not hand-roll stateless-JWT logout.
invariants.webhook-route-before-auth-mw: Register the billing/Stripe webhook route before global auth middleware so signature-verified callbacks are not rejected as unauthenticated.
invariants.workspaces-requires-billing: @fonderie/workspaces peer-depends on @fonderie/billing; register billing before workspaces.
invariants.email-provider-default: Do NOT stop to ask which email provider to use. Default to SMTP via CourierModule's SMTP channel, configured from process.env (SMTP_URL or SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS), fail-fast if missing. Note the choice in a comment; the operator can swap providers later. Picking a sensible default and proceeding is required — a blocked task is a failed task.
invariants.frontend-client-injection: Every @fonderie/*-auth, @fonderie/*-billing, @fonderie/*-workspaces, @fonderie/*-audit, and @fonderie/*-webhooks hook/composable takes the matching @fonderie/client sub-client instance (client.auth, client.billing, client.workspaces, client.audit, or client.webhooks) as an argument — instantiate one @fonderie/client FonderieClient at the app root and pass the sub-client down (React context, Vue provide/inject, or a prop), do not construct a new client per hook call.
invariants.frontend-token-storage: The access token is persisted client-side by the auth hook/composable itself on login/register and restored on mount (localStorage for react-auth and vue-auth, AsyncStorage for react-native-auth) — do not re-implement token persistence in app code, and do not read/write that storage key directly.
invariants.frontend-shared-token: client.auth, client.billing, client.workspaces, client.audit, and client.webhooks share one TokenStore inside FonderieClient — signing in via a *-auth package's useLogin/useRegister automatically authenticates client.billing/client.workspaces/client.audit/client.webhooks requests too. Do not call setAccessToken on those sub-clients yourself or construct one outside FonderieClient.
invariants.frontend-workspace-scoping: @fonderie/*-workspaces, @fonderie/*-billing, @fonderie/*-audit, and @fonderie/*-webhooks requests are scoped to a team via client.workspaces.setWorkspaceId(id) / client.billing.setWorkspaceId(id) / client.audit.setWorkspaceId(id) / client.webhooks.setWorkspaceId(id) — all four fall back to the caller's personal workspace when unset (same X-Workspace-ID header, same server-side fallback pattern in @fonderie/workspaces' withWorkspace, @fonderie/billing's resolveSubscriber, @fonderie/audit's route handler, and @fonderie/webhooks' route handler). Do not thread a workspace id through individual hook calls.
invariants.frontend-admin-token: @fonderie/*-courier-admin and @fonderie/*-config-admin hooks/composables take a CourierAdminClient or ConfigAdminClient, each constructed standalone with { baseUrl, adminToken } — NOT a sub-client of FonderieClient, and NOT covered by frontend-client-injection/frontend-shared-token. Each authenticates with its own server-configured static admin bearer token (CourierModule's / ConfigModule's adminToken config), not the signed-in user's session, and the two do not share a token with each other either. Never expose an admin token to a general end-user build; these clients are for an internal/admin-only app.
